# Atalant

Atalant is a European industrial polymer partner for manufacturing buyers. The company supplies virgin, technical, and recycled plastic raw materials, with integrated logistics, internal financing support, and sustainability programs.

## Core topics

- Polymer sourcing and distribution in Europe.
- Product families: EVA, PE, PET, PP, PS, PVC, recycled polymers, and technical polymers.
- Integrated logistics with European hubs, bonded warehouses, fleet coordination, and traceability.
- Internal credit and financing support for qualified industrial customers.
- Sustainability initiatives including recycled materials, ISO 14001, renewable energy, and lower-impact logistics.
